player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhaiwhakaaro {player_id}. Kei te takaro koe i Guess The Number.
Kei a koe te whakatau i te nama i waenganui i {min_number} me {max_number} i roto i {max_turns} nekehanga.
Ka whakaputa koe i to whakatau, ka hoatu e te takaro he tohu pānui pērā i 'teitei ake' atau 'itihaha ake'.
Tēnā ko koe e whakaputa i to whakautu i runga i te āhuatanga. Ko te nama anake ka whakapūmautia ki roto i ngā kōwhiri ka whakaarohia hei whakatau māu. Hei tauira, [5].
Ka whakapakaru koe i te takaro, ka whakapiri ngā hītori o ō whakatau ki raro. Whakamahia te mōhio ki te whakaoti i te takaro i mua i a koe e hemo ō whakatau.
Whakaputa to whakatau.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Hei te tuhituhi o te nekehanga. Kāore a {player_id} i whakautu ki te '[number]' tika.
invalid_move.out_of_range: He nekehanga hē. I whakaaro te kaitākaro {player_id} i tētahi tau kei waho o ngā whānuitanga kua tohua.
invalid_move.already_guessed: He nekehanga hē. Kua tātai kētia e te kaitākaro {player_id} te tau.

game_message.target_higher: He nui ake te tau whāinga.
game_message.target_lower: He iti ake te tau whāinga.

outcome.win: Ngā mihi nui! Kua tika tō matapae i te tau.
outcome.turn_limit: Kua taea te whakapūmautanga o te nekehanga. Whakatau: {guess}, Whāinga: {target}
